text:
Alex: FYI onboarding Ledgerly's LoRA adapter. Quickpack shows a "precision cliff" for small cents when using int4 under tight beam=1 decoding. Numbers like 0.05 sometimes produced as 0.00.

Priya: oh no. which quant and how was LoRA applied?

Alex: q4_0, runtime LoRA (applied at runtime to quant model). Command used:
```
./evalpack/run_quickpack.sh --model ledgerly-base-fp16 --adapter ledgerly-v1.lora.safetensors --quant q4_0 --prompts tests/ledgerly/cents.jsonl --decoding greedy
```
Small sample from quickpack: s3://redwood-evals/ledgerly/quickpack/1755550000/
{"id":"c-07","fp16":"0.05","q4":"0.00","delta":-0.05}
{"id":"c-12","fp16":"1.10","q4":"1.09","delta":-0.01}

Marcos: is this only with greedy/beam1? alternative decoding can hide quant jitter.

Alex: It is amplified by greedy. With beam=5 the q4 output matched fp16 more often but we can't force beam for customers.

Jin: try two experiments: A) merge LoRA into fp16 then quantize; B) use q4_aw asymmetric quant profile; also save per-token logits for failing examples.

Alex: queued both. Also adding a tiny synthetic set focused on sub-dollar amounts (0.01-0.99) repeated with different separators/currency symbols.

ci-bot: Adapter check: ledgerly-v1.lora passed signature and metadata scan.

Alex: merged-then-quant results: median delta improved from 0.02 -> 0.005 for cents set; still ~2% of samples drop the cent (0.05->0.00). runtime-LoRA-on-q4 stayed worse (~4% failures). Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/ledgerly/quickpack/1755550000/artifacts/

Priya: okay mitigation options for customer: 1) recommend merged-then-quant rollout for billing-critical routes, 2) use fp16 for amount-extraction endpoints, or 3) enforce deterministic post-processing: always round to 2 decimals and assert presence of digits.

Marcos: add a guard in Redwood routing: route currency-forming prompts to an fp16 model variant by default for customers who opt in. We should flag adapters that fail the cents test during onboarding.

Jin: also note this in the evalpack README: include a cents-focused test and a canary policy: if >3% failure rate on cents-set, block q4 rollout for that adapter.

Alex: noted. I'll add the cents pack and the delta-check script (evalpack/scripts/cent_diff.py) to artifacts. Will open a short customer-facing remediation note listing the three options.

Priya: and add a tiny prompt mitigation snippet customers can paste: "System: Return amounts as numeric string with exactly two decimals, do not abbreviate or drop cents."

Alex: done. tagging @marcos @jin for follow-up in tomorrow standup. :coffee:
